---
title: Tomato Baskets
id: MAR-0023
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 55
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 4 tomatoes
- 3 salted anchovies
- 3 slices of country bread
- 1 garlic clove
- 1 tablespoons of parsley
- 3 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Cut the bread into cubes of 1 cm on each side.
2. Bone the anchovies, desalt them, and cut them into small pieces.
3. Pour the oil into a non-stick pan and, when hot, add the chopped garlic and the anchovies, and let them melt, stirring with a wooden spoon.
4. Add the bread cubes and let them flavor for a few minutes, then sprinkle with the parsley.
5. Wash the tomatoes, remove the top, and partially hollow them out, removing the seeds.
6. Salt them lightly and fill them with the bread mixture and any cooking juices.
7. Place the tomatoes on the baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake at 200 °C for about 20-25 minutes.
